_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); defense prime contractor signals

pit_profile.why: 'In 2008, 84% of our net sales were made to the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor. Each of our business segments is heavily dependent on sales to the U.S. Government.' (FY2008 10-K, Item 1); 'Reduced funding for defense procurement and research and development programs could result in terminated or delayed contracts and adversely affect our ability to grow or maintain our sales and profitability.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and the 10-K names no offshore competition, so no disruption theme in scope is live

classification.quality_note: 'In 2008, 84% of our net sales were made to the U.S. Government, either as a prime contractor or as a subcontractor. Each of our business segments is heavily dependent on sales to the U.S. Government.' (FY2008 10-K, Item 1); 'Reduced funding for defense procurement and research and development programs could result in terminated or delayed contracts and adversely affect our ability to grow or maintain our sales and profitability.' (Item 1A): sales that depend on Congressional appropriations are not earnings that are the cycle, so DURABLE (the CAT and SO precedent); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery taking share in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and the 10-K names no offshore competition, so no disruption theme in scope is live. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price cheap; Ratio B -0.02x; -7% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.98; conservative 2yr +46%.

BEAR.desc: Flat EPS (worst year FY03-FY08, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.7%/yr (FY09 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 6.5-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +27.4%/yr (FY03-FY08 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +43.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY03-FY08); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: LMT (retrospective, 2009-06-26) ◉ BUY — Ratio B -0.02x (-2.5% downside to Bear $83 / +156.9% upside to Bull $208) | Adj composite 2.35 vs market 1.37: gap +0.98 [UNDERVALUED] | -7% above the EPP floor $87 (12x FY09E $7.25) | Conservative 2-yr case: +45.7% total (+22.9%/yr) | At 11.2x FY09E the 15% hurdle price $107 sits at or below the BASE case; backlog +8.2% in Q1 2009, forward revenues +4.6-6.9% (FY09 net sales guide); OFFSHORE (live from 2004-11-05) is scoped to offshore delivery in Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing, and the 10-Ks name no offshore competition; no theme in scope has dated evidence.
